title: 第三十九章 死里逃生第三十八章 反噬之险
content_zh:
江砚是被一阵颠簸晃醒的。
他先是觉得冷，继而是疼——那疼不在某一处，是从骨头缝里、从五脏六腑里漫出来的，像被人拆开了重新拼过。他喉头一阵腥气，挣扎着想张嘴，却只发出一声微弱的、破风箱似的喘。
“砚哥儿！”
秦伯的脸凑了过来，糊在他模糊的视野里。老头满头大汗，眼睛通红，那张沟壑纵横的脸上，又是惊又是喜。
“醒了，醒了就好……”秦伯的声音直发颤，一只手还死死攥着他的手腕在号脉，“你这一口气，差点就……差点就回不来了。”
江砚费力地转动眼珠。
他发现自己被秦伯半搂着，背靠在一堵冰凉的墙上。这不是卫府的花厅了，是一处昏暗逼仄的所在，像是后院的一条夹道。天色擦黑，头顶只有一线灰蒙蒙的暮光。
“这是……哪儿……”他声音哑得几乎听不见。
“还在卫府。”秦伯压低嗓子，眼里的喜色又被惊惧盖了下去，“你昏过去之后，那姓卫的没安好心。当着满堂的客，他不好动手，可那些人一散——”
老头话没说完，夹道那头，便传来一阵杂沓的脚步声。
江砚心里一沉。
来人有四五个，清一色的黑衣，腰里挎刀，步子又轻又稳。这不是卫府寻常的家丁，是养着的死士。当头一个，面无表情地走过来，居高临下地看着墙根下这一老一少。
“卫公子有令。”那死士声音没有半分起伏，“这小子的本事，公子要‘留’下来。活的死的都成——会造物的那双手，那颗心，留着就行。”
江砚浑身的血，都凉了。
吞服精血、留手、留心——这就是卫家摹刻的歪路。他们要的，从来不是请他投效，是把他当成一块拓物的料子，剥了去。
“想动我家娃子，”秦伯把江砚往身后一护，声音抖，骨头却硬，“先从我老头子身上踏过去！”
死士眼皮都没抬，手按上了刀柄。
那刀“锵”地出鞘半寸，寒光一闪。
江砚撑着墙，想站起来，可他七窍刚渗过血，浑身一点力气都没有，刚一动，眼前就又是一阵发黑。他攥紧了那支贴身的秃笔——
不行。他造不了了。再强造，他立时就得死。

完了。这个念头冷冰冰地砸下来。师徒两个，今日要交代在这卫府的夹道里了。
死士的刀，抽了出来。
就在那刀锋将落未落的刹那——
夹道尽头那堵高墙的墙头上，毫无征兆地，翻下一道身影。
那身影落地极轻，几乎没有声息，可手里那一道剑光，却快得像一道撕开暮色的白线。
“铮——!”
当头那死士的刀，被那道剑光从中崩开，虎口迸裂，刀脱手飞了出去。那死士一声闷哼，捂着手腕踉跄后退。
来人立定。
是个女子。一身利落的劲装，外罩一件半旧的灰斗篷，斗篷的兜帽被方才那一跃带得滑落下来，露出一张冷硬清绝的脸。她手里那柄剑还在微微震颤，剑尖斜指地面，滴着一线血。
江砚怔住了。
这张脸——
“是你。”他几乎以为自己烧糊涂了。
那个雪夜闯进铺子求医避祸的将门孤女。那个伤愈即走、留下一枚旧物的女子。
苏挽。
content_en:
Jiang Yan was woken up by a jolt.
He felt cold first, then pain - the pain was not in one place, but came from the seams in the bones and from the internal organs, as if someone had taken it apart and put it back together again. There was a fishy smell in his throat, and he struggled to open his mouth, but he only let out a weak, broken bellows-like gasp.
"Brother Yan!"
Uncle Qin's face came closer and was blurred in his blurred vision. The old man was sweating profusely, his eyes were red, and his face with crisscrossed grooves was filled with surprise and joy.
"Wake up, just wake up..." Uncle Qin's voice was trembling, and one hand was still holding his wrist tightly to check his pulse, "You almost... almost couldn't come back after you took this breath."
Jiang Yan rolled his eyes hard.
He found himself half-armed by Uncle Qin, with his back leaning against a cold wall. This is no longer the flower hall of the Wei Mansion, but a dark and cramped place, like a passage in the backyard. The sky was dark, with only a ray of gray twilight overhead.
"Where is..." His voice was so hoarse that it was almost inaudible.
"Still in the Wei Mansion." Uncle Qin lowered his voice, and the joy in his eyes was covered by fear again, "After you passed out, the man named Wei had no good intentions. In front of a hall full of guests, he couldn't do anything, but as soon as those people dispersed-"
Before the old man finished speaking, there was a burst of footsteps from the other end of the road.
Jiang Yan's heart sank.
There were four or five people coming, all dressed in black, with knives at their waists, and their steps were light and steady. This is not an ordinary servant of the Wei Mansion, he is a dead soldier. The first one walked over expressionlessly and looked condescendingly at the old man and the young man under the wall.
"Young Master Wei has an order." The dead soldier's voice did not waver at all. "Young Master must 'keep' this boy's ability. Live or die - just keep his hands and heart that can create things."
The blood all over Jiang Yan's body turned cold.
Swallowing blood essence, keeping hands, and paying attention - this is the crooked path imitated by the Wei family. What they wanted was never to ask him to serve, but to treat him as a piece of material and peel it off.
"If you want to touch my baby," Uncle Qin pushed Jiang Yan behind him, his voice trembling but his bones hard, "Step over my old man first!"
The dead soldier didn't even raise his eyelids, and put his hand on the handle of the knife.
The knife came out of its sheath half an inch with a clang, and a cold light flashed.
Jiang Yan supported the wall and wanted to stand up, but blood had just seeped out of his seven orifices and he had no strength at all. As soon as he moved, his eyesight turned black again. He tightened his grip on the close-fitting bald pen——
No. He can't make it. If he continues to force himself, he will die immediately.
It's over. This thought hit me coldly. The two masters and apprentices have to explain themselves in the corridor of the Wei Mansion today.
The dead man's knife was drawn out.
At that moment when the blade was about to fall——
On top of the high wall at the end of the corridor, without any warning, a figure climbed down.
The figure fell to the ground very lightly, making almost no sound, but the sword light in his hand was as fast as a white thread tearing through the twilight.
"Zheng——!"
The sword of the dead soldier at the head was shattered by the sword light, the tiger's mouth burst open, and the sword flew out. The dead soldier groaned, covered his wrists and staggered back.
Come and stand.
It's a woman. He was dressed in neat attire, covered with a half-worn gray cloak. The hood of the cloak slipped off due to the leap just now, revealing a cold and pure face. The sword in her hand was still trembling slightly, and the tip of the sword pointed diagonally at the ground, dripping with a line of blood.
Jiang Yan was stunned.
This face——
"It's you." He almost thought he was confused.
The orphan girl who broke into the shop on a snowy night to seek medical advice to avoid trouble. The woman who recovered from her injuries and left, leaving behind an old thing.
Su Wan.
